registrationPolicy: Original baseline is translated without resizing. Every generated sheet uses a uniform 0.8 scale: approximately 433 source pixels of upright body height become 346 pixels, matching the baseline. Each sheet has one horizontal anchor. Ground registration translates each complete pose vertically to y500; it never changes pose proportions or body scale. Alpha below32 removes diffuse generated background haze. Final pixel frames use one shared24-color palette and a uniform fivefold reduction.
